Mechanism: windowed-sponsor-cap
How: Inside each 6-block window a raven signs the seat pulse, and that same plume may back only 3 seats.
Cost: the 4th key on the plume pays a 0.35 fee, and quorum weight then drops by 1 across 12 epochs.
Check: settlement sorts those pulse times and charges the fee once 3 of the last 4 sponsors match.
